title: Modeling Data Concurrency w/ Asynchronous I/O in Zig - RedisConf 2020
summary: Zig creator Andrew Kelley's RedisConf 2020 talk on modeling data flow with asynchronous I/O in Zig. It explains how Zig's async/await avoids function coloring, and Loris Cro demonstrates OkRedis, a zero-allocation Redis client.
why: HN recommends it as the clearest explanation of how Zig achieves colorless async/await.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: I highly recommend watching Andrew Kelley's video
